title: Mastrao Visio usage information
introduction: This page describes how to use Mastrao Visio. Contractual information for your instance still needs to be confirmed with your Mastrao representative.

sections.title: Service
paragraphs: Mastrao Visio lets you organize and join videoconferences in Mastrao.

sections.title: Meeting access
paragraphs: Organizers share the meeting link with participants. Access depends on the room’s permissions and settings.

sections.title: Microphone, camera and sharing
paragraphs: Participants can use their microphone, camera, screen sharing and messaging according to the features enabled. Check what information you make visible or audible before sharing.

sections.title: Recording and transcription
paragraphs: Recording and transcription depend on the features enabled on this instance. Inform participants and obtain their agreement before using them. Access to results depends on the Mastrao configuration.

sections.title: Availability and assistance
paragraphs: Support arrangements and any service commitments must be confirmed with your Mastrao representative. The certifications, availability targets and response times of the original DINUM service do not describe this instance.

sections.title: Open source software
paragraphs: Mastrao Visio is adapted from Meet / La Suite Numérique by DINUM and its contributors. The original code remains under the MIT license and retains its copyright notices.
